node.statement: Typed inversion derivative with chart retention: there exist universal C_der, C_ch, C_pol, C_grp >= 1 and kappa_der, kappa_ch, kappa_pol in (0, 1/2] such that for every finite-dimensional exact-unit epsilon_r-C*-algebra, s in {+1, -1}, and 0 < r <= delta satisfying C_ch*(epsilon_r + delta) <= kappa_ch, C_pol*(epsilon_r + delta) <= kappa_pol, C_grp*epsilon_r < delta - C_pol*(epsilon_r*delta + delta^2), C_der*(epsilon_r + r) <= kappa_der, and (1 + epsilon_r)*(1 + C_ch*(epsilon_r + delta))*r + C_grp*epsilon_r < 2*delta, the globally defined sigma(U) = u_delta(U^dagger) maps chi_s(B_r^{icalH}(0)) into the same sJ-graph chart, where chi_s(A) = sJ bold-dot (J + A + g_{sJ}(A)), and F_s(A) = phi_{sJ}^par(sigma(chi_s(A))) satisfies ||D(F_s - id)(A) + 2*I_{icalH}|| <= C_der*(epsilon_r + r) for all A in B_r^{icalH}(0).
